assertions.title: Portfolio setup success transitions into main app

steps.observed: Welcome screen displayed with portfolio input and Get Started button

steps.action: Enter portfolio size 10000 and click Get Started
steps.observed: Portfolio updated to 10000, UI navigated to /planner route
Layout showing Planner, Open Trades, History, Analytics tabs and trade planning form

frictions.description: Initial API calls had double /api prefix (PUT /api/api/portfolio instead of /api/portfolio), causing portfolio updates to fail silently.
frictions.resolution: Fixed frontend/src/api/portfolio.ts to use /portfolio, /portfolio, /portfolio/reset instead of /api/portfolio, /api/portfolio, /api/portfolio/reset since base URL is already /api

summary: Tested 1 assertion: 1 passed (VAL-UI-003). Portfolio setup flow now correctly transitions from welcome screen to main trading layout after successful portfolio update. Bug fixed: API endpoint path had duplicate /api prefix.
